referees.quote: I recommend publication of this paper in Nature Communications, but would like to request some more detailed descriptions as commented below
This work is entirely suited for publication in Nature Communications (or Nature Physics for that matter). I have the following questions and suggestions to improve the manuscript and analysis
Experimentally, these charge states can be confirmed using Kelvin parabolas showing the LCPD using nc-AFM. To unambiguously verify the proposed mechanism, such measurements are essential.

note: Recommendations are taken from Version 0, the first round in this file. The authors' list of changes says the manuscript was transferred from Nature Physics, so any earlier Nature Physics review round is not included here. No referee used the scale terms, so all three levels are inferred. R1 and R2 support publication and ask mainly for clarifications, context and added details, so they are rated minor revision. R3 gives no overall verdict but calls new nc-AFM/Kelvin parabola measurements 'essential' and asks for substantially expanded discussion, so they are rated major revision. No referee co-signed another's report. All three recommended acceptance in Version 1.
